name: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd
title: ICICI Life Insurance Ltd - 540133 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Life insurer grew VNB 10.9% to ₹26.29bn with margin up 190bp to 24.7%, but APE grew only 2.2% and RoEV fell to 11.9% on negative persistency and assumption changes; growth guidance withheld.

triggers.label: FY26 APE growth only 2.2%
triggers.quote: On a full year basis, APE grew by 2.2% year-on-year to ₹ 106.41 billion.

triggers.label: VNB margin 22.8% → 24.7%
triggers.quote: VNB margin expanded by 190 basis points year -on-year to 24.7% in the current year.

triggers.label: Persistency variance ₹2.64bn negative
triggers.quote: Persistency variance is a negative ₹ 2.64 billion, which is largely on account of the 100% premium back annuity product

triggers.label: March sales hit by West Asia war
triggers.quote: I do believe that the war in West Asia has, to some extent, impacted new business sales in the month of March.

guidance.quote: it's a little early for us to commit as to what the number should look like for the rest of the year.

red_flags.label: Persistency and assumption drag on EV
red_flags.quote: Consequently, the RoEV for FY2026 stands at 11.9%.

red_flags.label: Agency and direct growth weak, APE 2.2%
red_flags.quote: agency has not had a great year in the sense, the growth has not been great.

evasions.quote: it's a little early for us to commit as to what the number should look like for the rest of the year.
I don't know what the regulator is thinking on that front. So, it will be a little difficult to comment.
